acceptance.scope: Observed-value guards and conditional uncertainty, not population noninferiority.

hard_minus_d.scope: Conditional paired whole-group resampling within domains after averaging fixed paired seeds; observed-value guards, not population noninferiority

hard_minus_schedule.scope: Conditional paired whole-group resampling within domains after averaging fixed paired seeds; observed-value guards, not population noninferiority

schedule_minus_d.scope: Conditional paired whole-group resampling within domains after averaging fixed paired seeds; observed-value guards, not population noninferiority

interpretation: Only hard minus d E6 is primary. Auxiliary comparisons are unadjusted descriptive evidence; no selection of arm, seed or epoch; synthetic repeatedly developed valid only.

encoder_schedule.definition: one-based t=1..864: peak*t/87 for t<=87, then peak*(864-t)/(864-87)

evaluation.automatic_threshold: unchanged train-only calibration, diagnostic, not acceptance
evaluation.model_selection: None; hard E6 is primary, s0 fixed for any later separately authorized test
evaluation.scope: Conditional paired whole-group resampling within domains after averaging fixed paired seeds; observed-value guards, not population noninferiority

policy.execution_boundary: Implementation preparation approved; formal runtime/storage and new supervision remain proposed until the user receives readiness report and explicitly starts the scoped run. A separate authorization receipt is required by execute; the policy itself remains byte-frozen.

hard_ranking.reduction: mean over queries, within each query mean over all positive-by-selected-negative combinations
hard_ranking.selection: highest current logits among known within-group negatives; exclude self and every positive; stable ascending candidate index for exact ties
hard_ranking.selection_gradients: indices detached, selected score values differentiable
